name: +1 Step = 1 Jump
desc:
⚡ +1 Step = 1 Jump ⚡

PREMIUM USERS GET 1.5 JUMPS
INVITE FRIENDS FOR A x.5 JUMP BOOST

How to play:
🦘 Each step gives jumps to level up
⬆️ Jump through higher and higher platforms
🏆 Reach win pads to earn wins
💪 Upgrade your jumps and bonuses in the lobby
🔄 Rebirth to raise limits and unlock multipliers
⚡ Climb as high as you can and reach the top!

👟 Keep moving and keep jumping. How high can you reach?
